title: docs(spec): the package-less row entry's remedy deletes the package-less row first, and saves a code package's customization in its .custom pair
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXJAMZYj59b5X3KNNXXrJPe)_
Fixes #32968

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：#32568 升级指南条目 `package-less-row-exact-address-by-type-class` 的补救写法和对应 changeset 的 The fix 段。现在先读出并保存包外行的正文（从 `GET /api/v1/data/sys_metadata` 读），先清掉同名已绑包的行，再删包外行，最后保存；代码包的定制存到它的 `.custom` 配对包，可写包才用 `?package=<持有方>`。另外写明：代码包发布同名时，flow、action、doc、mapping 和无覆盖通道的封闭类型（skill 除外）的包外删除返回 403，这些行没有元数据接口能删，留着也不被任何读取服务。
- 为什么改：在 main 上实测，按原顺序（先存后删）不带包的删除会删掉刚存的那份定制，包外行却留着，属于数据丢失。另外对代码包传 `?package=<持有方>` 保存会返回 403。
- 风险与回滚：只改文字，不改任何答案、键或导出。回滚即 revert 本 PR。本 PR 有意改写了 #32568 尚未发版的 note（见 DELIBERATE CORRECTION 一节），`Check Changeset` 按设计保持红。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.package-less-row-exact-address-by-type-class.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：读 `replacement` 与 `acceptanceCriteria` 两段，对照下面的实测表。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The ADR-0087 entry #32568 registered (`package-less-row-exact-address-by-type-class`, in 18.4.0's upgrade guide) prescribed: save the customization, then delete the package-less row. Measured on `main` (`25ee50765`), that order loses the user's change:

- A delete naming no package addresses the one package the name's rows are bound to (the save door's resolution, `packagelessAddress` / `packagelessDraftAddress`). Run after the save, it removes the row just saved and leaves the package-less row.
- A save at `?package=<holder>` answers `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` when the holder is a code package, naming its `.custom` pair.

The entry's `replacement` now gives the remedy as steps, each measured or read on `main`:

1. Read and keep the package-less row's stored body first. A holder's exact address does not serve it (a sealed type's row is served by no read); its `sys_metadata` record does (`GET /api/v1/data/sys_metadata`, filtered by type, name and state with `package_id` null; `sys-metadata.object.ts` opens `get` and `list` on that object, and the body is its `metadata` field). The delete hard-deletes the row and a draft leaves no history copy, so the kept body is the only copy a refused save can be retried from (contract review must-fix 1).
2. Check the same list for rows of the name bound to a package. A delete naming no package addresses the one package the name's rows are bound to: for an active row, a bound row at that state; for a draft, the item's ACTIVE rows decide (their package's own draft is removed, and with active rows bound to two or more packages the delete answers `409` whatever drafts exist). Such a row is kept, deleted at its own address, and re-saved there after the package-less delete; it is folded into the saved change only when it belongs to the package that change goes to (should-fix 3; r2 review should-fix 1 and 2).
3. Delete the package-less row (its receipt names no package), then save: a writable holder at `?package=ID`; a code package in `?package=ID.custom` with `overrides: { package: ID, basedOn }`. Run after the save, the same delete removes the change just saved.
4. When a code package ships the name, the package-less delete of `flow`, `action`, `doc`, `mapping` and every type of (2b) but `skill` answers `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, sealed against removal (`refusePackagedBaseRemoval`: artifact-backed, no `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, no `supportsOverlay`). No metadata door removes that row; it stays stored and served by no read, and the remedy skips the delete there: for the (2a) types the declared override is saved, for (2b) the change ships as before (must-fix 2). Per kernel topology, measured: `hook`, `action` and `flow` answer 403 on both; `job`, `queue` and `agent` answer 403 on an environment kernel and are removed on a host-config kernel, whose delete door takes the legacy path for a type with `allowRuntimeCreate: false` (r3 review should-fix 1). `sharing_rule`, `assignment_rule` and `api` share those flags and were not run.

`acceptanceCriteria` name the address the saved draft answers at, allow the 403-sealed row to remain, and require every package-bound row cleared on the way to be back at its own address. `.changeset/32568-package-less-row-sealed-and-draft-exits.md`'s "The fix" says the same. A new `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset records the text change.

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION

`Check Changeset` refuses the edit of `.changeset/32568-package-less-row-sealed-and-draft-exits.md`, a pending note on the merge base that this PR did not add. It is not a filename collision: #32968 exists to correct that note, whose remedy order is measured false (table below), and restoring the base text would republish it. Named note: `.changeset/32568-package-less-row-sealed-and-draft-exits.md`. Sentences corrected:

- BEFORE `The fix:` · AFTER `The fix (first read and keep the package-less row's stored body …; then check the same list for rows of the name bound to a package … for a draft it is decided by the item's ACTIVE rows … Clear such a row first: keep its body, delete it at its own address ?package=<its package>, and after the package-less delete re-save it at that same address; fold it into the change saved below only when it belongs to the package that change goes to … then delete the package-less row …, and only then save, because run after the save the same delete removes the change just saved):`
- BEFORE `… TO saving the customization under the one package it customizes, then deleting the package-less row.` · AFTER `… TO deleting the package-less draft, then saving it under the package it customizes: ?package=<holder> for a writable (authored) holder; for a code package … the holder's paired .custom package (?package=<holder>.custom with overrides: { package: <holder>, basedOn }), where ?package=<holder>.custom&state=draft then answers it.`
- BEFORE `… TO a declared override in the holder's paired .custom package (ADR-0146), then deleting the package-less row.` · AFTER `… TO deleting the package-less row, then a declared override in the holder's paired .custom package (ADR-0146). When a code package ships the name, the package-less delete of a flow, action, doc or mapping row answers 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE (sealed against removal): no metadata door removes that row, it stays stored and served by no read, and the declared override is saved without the delete.`
- BEFORE `… TO deleting the package-less row and shipping the change in a new version …` · AFTER `… TO deleting the package-less row (when a code package ships the name, that delete answers 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE for hook everywhere, and for every other one of these but skill on an environment kernel; there the row stays stored and served by no read, while a host-config kernel removes the row of a type that allows no runtime creation: job, queue, sharing_rule, assignment_rule, agent, api) and shipping the change in a new version …`

The diff also changes code text (the ADR-0087 entry), so this is confirmed by the same-head at-tier contract-review PASS (pm-dispatch `references/landing-operations.md`). The gate stays red by design. The same declaration is on the PR as comment 6841100444 (written at `f2642c6b0`; the third and fourth bullets above are new at `7441aa675`, the first bullet's bound-row clause was rewritten at `bf6e09b9b`, and the fourth bullet's 403 sentence is per kernel topology at `f36b5fea3`).

### Measured (real `ObjectQL` engine and `SchemaRegistry`, the boot of `environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts`, `email_template` and `dashboard` unless named)

| Case | As written (save, then delete) | Corrected (delete, then save) |
|---|---|---|
| (1) Two code holders, package-less draft: save at `?package=<holder>` | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` naming the pair | (not the path) |
| (1) Two code holders: draft saved at `?package=<holder>.custom` with `overrides` | both rows kept until the delete; the delete removes the package-less draft; the pair's draft answers at `?package=<holder>.custom&state=draft` | same end state: pair draft kept, package-less draft gone |
| (1) A writable (authored) holder: draft saved at `?package=<holder>` | the delete removes the draft just saved; the package-less draft stays and is still served | package-less draft gone; `?package=<holder>&state=draft` answers the saved draft |
| (2a) `dataset`, declared override in `<holder>.custom` | the delete removes the override; the package-less row stays; `?package=<holder>` answers the shipped item | override kept, package-less row gone; `?package=<holder>` answers the override |
| `dataset`, a `.custom` override stored BEFORE the remedy, beside the package-less active row | first package-less delete removes the override; receipt: `Customization overlay deleted (package=…custom) … its package-less row remains`; a second removes the package-less row | (the precondition the entry now states: clear the bound row at its own address first) |
| `action` and `flow` shipped by a code package, package-less active row, both topologies | package-less delete: `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` sealed against removal, row stays | `?package=<holder>.custom` delete answers success and removes nothing; `?package=<holder>`: 403 (environment kernel), success and nothing removed (host-config); the row stays; an engine read of `sys_metadata` returns it with its body |
| `job`, `queue`, `agent`, `hook` shipped by a code package, package-less active row | environment kernel: all four `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` sealed against removal, row stays | host-config kernel: `job`, `queue`, `agent` deleted (`reset to artifact default`), row gone; `hook` `403`, row stays |
| `email_template` and `dashboard`, two code holders, an active override in each `.custom` pair, package-less draft | package-less draft delete: `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both, nothing deleted | delete the second pair's override at `?package=<holder2>.custom` (receipt names it), then the package-less draft delete discards it; save the draft in `<holder1>.custom`, re-save the second override: `<holder1>.custom` draft and both overrides answer at their addresses |

After the corrected remedy with a code holder, `?package=<holder>&state=draft` answers 404 (no draft at the base's address; the draft is the pair's), which is why the acceptance criteria now name `?package=ID.custom&state=draft` for a code package. The written order happened to survive the two-code-holder draft case because no active row binds the name there; the corrected order is the one that holds in every case measured.

Probes: `/mnt/project-files/issue-32968/remedy-probe.test.ts.txt` and `remedy-probe-r2.test.ts.txt` and `remedy-probe-r3.test.ts.txt`, `remedy-probe-r4.test.ts.txt` beside it (a copy of the five-types boot; its `sys_metadata` double gains `draft_changes`, which the draft save writes). Not measured: the REST data read itself (`GET /api/v1/data/sys_metadata`); it is read from the object's `apiMethods: ['get', 'list']`. `doc`, `mapping`, `sharing_rule`, `assignment_rule` and `api` are read from their type flags, not run.

## Acceptance notes

- The writable-holder case was measured with one registry holder (an authored package's saved item is a stored row, not a registry holder in this harness); the trap is in the delete's address resolution and does not depend on the holder count.
- Branch note: this branch held card #32820's on-hold work (`0637a5006`, recorded on #32820). A force push to restart it was refused, so `74a36e1f6` returns those seven files to `main`'s text; this PR's diff against `main` is the three files above. #32820's commits remain in the branch history and as patches beside that card.
- First-party count: no first-party composition stores a package-less row of a name a package holds; text only.
